 OIL PRICE WATCH: Big fuel price rollbacks likely next week
 ABS-CBN News
 Published November 20, 2026 01:28 PM PHT 
 MANILA — Fuel prices continue to fall in the world market, boosting expectations for fresh rollbacks next week.
 Based on the fourth trading day in Singapore’s Mean of Platts, prices have fallen by the following amounts per liter:
 Diesel - P2.67 decrease
 Gasoline - P2.47 decrease
 ADVERTISEMENT
 Kerosene - P1.88 decrease
 These prices are not final, as there is one more trading day left in the week. Crude oil prices have been falling in the world market since the Democrats swept the US midterm elections this month, raising hopes that the US-Israeli war vs. Iran would soon get resolved.
 Oil prices skyrocketed in March following the outbreak of the US-Israeli war on Iran, which shut off the crucial Strait of Hormuz, through which 20 percent of the world’s oil supply passes.
